text: Rumors say TechCorp is developing a new AI chip called NebulaX. Analysts expect high performance.
TechCorp's stock rose today. Sources confirm the NebulaX project is real and led by Dr. Smith.
Dr. Smith, the chief architect at TechCorp, previously worked on the Alpha chip. He is focused on NebulaX efficiency.
Breaking: TechCorp officially announces NebulaX. It claims to be 10x faster than competitors.
Reviewers are testing NebulaX from TechCorp. Dr. Smith says this is just the beginning.
